onset: 2026-03-17T09:23:00.000Z
The error_rate jumped dramatically from 0.0024 at 09:22 (metrics/http.csv:24) to 0.1255 at 09:23 (metrics/http.csv:25), a 52x increase. This coincides with the deploy at 09:22 (changes.jsonl:2) of v2026.3.17-a1 adding 'tiered discount support'. The p95_ms also began climbing from ~190ms to eventually 378ms, while p50_ms remained stable (37-47ms range), suggesting errors are failing fast while successful requests are unaffected. The rps stayed relatively flat (316-364 range), indicating this is not a load issue but a code defect. The CheckoutErrorRateHigh alert fired at 09:27 (alerts.jsonl:1), confirming the error rate threshold breach. The stable p50_ms and rps act as controls showing the infrastructure is healthy - this is an application logic bug introduced in the checkout tiered discount code.

Reply with a single JSON object and nothing else:
{
  "root_cause": one of bad_deploy_regression | resource_exhaustion_pool | memory_leak | downstream_dependency_failure | cache_stampede | disk_exhaustion | config_change | certificate_expiry | dns_failure | upstream_rate_limit | schema_migration_regression | batch_job_contention,

  "onset_ts": "ISO timestamp when the incident began",
  "timeline": [{ "statement": "...", "citations": [{"source": "...", "line": N, "quote": "..."}] }],
  "evidence": [{ "statement": "why this is the cause", "citations": [...] }],
  "ruled_out": [{ "statement": "what you considered and rejected, and why", "citations": [...] }],
  "action_items": ["..."]
}

Every entry in timeline, evidence and ruled_out needs at least one citation.
In "quote", copy a distinctive fragment of the text that appears on that exact
line, verbatim. A citation whose quote is not on the line it names is rejected.
